_schema_note: Three-quarter scene. Anchors are screen points from core/scene.ts, not grid coordinates. house.sprite resolves against assets/houses; a hatched placeholder draws until art lands.

decoys.why: Intentional native/xeriscape planting: stone border, decomposed granite field, plants on deliberate spacing. Chapter 202 Texas Property Code limits Association authority over drought-tolerant landscaping. Citing this loses on appeal.

notes_for_designer: The decoy, at the SAME anchor as 4412 so the player cannot pattern-match on position.
